 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Akshay Latwal, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No. 88 of 2024, under Section 376 & 506 Ipc, Police Station
Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, in the year 2019, the husband of the victim has gone to Gujarat for job.
The victim was staying in her house.
During this period, the applicant came close to her and offered assistance to the victim.
On 22.04.2020, the applicant offered some medicine to the victim.
When the victim consumed that medicine, she was intoxicated.
The FIR records that at that moment, the applicant raped her, took her photographs and thereafter, blackmailed her and established physical relations with the victim on multiple occasions.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant had filed a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 against the victim and her husband.
Notice had already been served on 22.12.2023 on the victim and her husband.
Thereafter, a false FIR has been lodged.
It is argued that there has been no photograph.
Nothing has been recovered by the police during investigation.
Nothing was given by the victim to the police.
5. The Court wanted to know from learned State counsel about any video or photograph?
6. Learned State counsel, under instruction, would submit that the victim is not cooperating with the investigation.
She has not given any photograph or video to the Investigating Officer.

sentences.text: 7. State to file objections.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner whatsoever, the victim or any other witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 15.03.2024 Jitendra Jeewan Ram vs State Of Uttarakhand on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140754045/
